# Second Room

> Second Room is a Singapore capital-markets advisory that helps leadership teams clarify strategy, frame conviction, and build investor trust from pre-IPO storytelling through listing and post-listing engagement. Founded by Grace Chen, Second Room Pte Ltd combines advisory, learning programmes, and curated market conversations.

Second Room works with boards, founders, and listed-company teams on how a business is understood, followed, and valued. The work follows three movements: define the investment case, structure an investor-relations operating system, and reinforce that understanding across earnings, disclosure, and investor engagement.

Second Room Pte Ltd is based at 176 Orchard Road, The Centrepoint, #05-05, Singapore 238843.
Enquiries: hello@secondrm.com · +65 9759 3233

## Offerings

- [Our Offerings](https://www.secondrm.com/our-offerings.html): Overview of Strategic Advisory, SR Academy, and SR Studio, and how the three practices work together.
- [Strategic Advisory](https://www.secondrm.com/strategicadvisory.html): Bespoke capital-markets IR advisory covering diagnostic and positioning, narrative and disclosure systems, earnings and event readiness, market engagement, and AI interpretability.
- [SR Academy](https://www.secondrm.com/sr-academy.html): Practical programmes that install investor-relations discipline, including Core Build Lab and the Strategic IR Foundation workshop with SGlistcos.
- [SR Studio](https://www.secondrm.com/sr-studio.html): Executive roundtables, investor forums, thought-leadership media, and multi-partner convenings that connect strategy, capital, and meaning.

## Programmes

- [Core Build Lab](https://www.secondrm.com/corebuildlab.html): A 4-session, in-company build over 4–6 weeks (S$8,500) for SGX-listed teams to install mandate, cadence, equity story, disclosure discipline, and rehearsal readiness. Delivered live in Singapore or online.
- [Register interest](https://www.secondrm.com/register.html): Registration form for the Core Build Lab programme.
